narration: Did you actually take your 401k when you switched jobs? Most people don't — and right now there's $1.65 trillion sitting in abandoned accounts. Some of it might be yours.
visual: Dark background. SVG briefcase springs in from center with amber glow. Animated counter climbs from $0 to $1.65T in large white text. Subtext: 'In Abandoned 401ks'. Question fades in: 'Is some of it yours?'

narration: Once you leave a company, your 401k becomes an orphan account. You're stuck in whatever expensive funds the plan offered — zero power to switch, zero power to negotiate. You just pay.
visual: Light background. Amber piggy bank SVG springs in. Red padlock SVG slams on top of the piggy bank. Red label: 'ORPHAN ACCOUNT'. Red text: 'Stuck in High-Fee Funds'.

narration: Here's the math. Old 401k plans charge former employees up to 0.8% more per year in fees. On $150,000 over twenty years, that quietly compounds into $116,000 gone — just in extra fees.
visual: Dark background. Two bars grow side by side: red 'FORGOTTEN' bar stops at $150K, green 'ROLLED OVER' bar reaches $266K. Amber '+$116K' badge pops above the gap. Source callout: '$116,000 stolen in excess fees.'

narration: Here's the trap — the account keeps growing and statements keep arriving, so nothing feels broken. That's exactly how 24 million orphan accounts stay forgotten for decades, leaking thousands every year.
visual: Light background. Gray person silhouette stands relaxed. Calendar beside them flips through months — Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct, Dec, Year 2. Red callout box: 'Looks fine to me.' Sub-text: 'That's how 24 million accounts stay lost.'

narration: The fix takes fifteen minutes. Call your new employer's plan or open an IRA, request a direct rollover — zero taxes, zero penalties. It's the simplest six-figure move you'll ever make.
visual: Dark background. Red 'OLD 401K' box on left. Amber animated arrow slides across. Green 'YOUR IRA' box appears on right. Large amber '15 MIN' text. Green callout: 'Zero taxes. Zero penalties. Zero fees.'

narration: Go right now — find your old 401k or call that old HR department. Three steps, fifteen minutes, and you could recover $116,000 you've been leaving on the table. Follow for more money traps nobody explains.
visual: Light background. Three amber checkmark items appear one by one: '1. LIST YOUR OLD JOBS', '2. CALL OLD HR / PLAN', '3. REQUEST ROLLOVER'. Large amber '$116,000' springs in. Black CTA box: 'Follow for more money traps nobody explains.'
